title: Efficient Energy use in Iron Ore Mining Operations
description: Improve energy efficiency in iron ore mining operations specifically in crushing and grinding processes to reduce energy consumption operational costs and environmental impact through AI-driven optimization process simulation and renewable energy integration.

title: Development of a Virtual Reality Simulator for Training in Chemical Disaster Response
description: Develop a Virtual Reality simulator to train NDRF personnel in handling chemical disasters replicating realistic environments allowing trainees to practice critical skills without real-world danger supporting multi-user training performance evaluation and scenario customization.

title: Structural Stability Assessment Tool for Collapsed Structures
description: Develop a mobile or simulation-based tool to assess structural stability of collapsed buildings during disaster scenarios helping determine safe entry points estimate load-bearing capacity and identify hazards with GIS integration photo upload and offline functionality.

title: Integrated Wearable Device for Real-Time Monitoring of Vital Parameters Gas Exposure and Fatigue
description: Develop a wearable device for real-time monitoring of vital signs gas exposure and fatigue in rescue operations transmitting data wirelessly providing alerts and storing data for post-operation analysis to improve responder safety in hazardous environments.

title: Development of Radar-Based Living Person Detection System for Use Under the Rubble
description: Develop a portable radar-based system to detect living persons trapped under rubble after disasters effective in various conditions capable of detecting vital signs through debris to aid rescue operations with rapid and accurate life detection.

title: Low-Cost Decentralized Smart Air Purification and Monitoring System for Delhi-NCR
description: Design and develop a low-cost decentralized smart air purification and monitoring system for the Delhi-NCR region measuring air pollutants identifying pollution sources and providing localized air purification using IoT-enabled adaptive filters.

title: AI-Driven Pollution Source Identification Forecasting and Policy Dashboard for Delhi-NCR
description: Develop a software platform to identify pollution sources in Delhi-NCR forecast air quality and provide a policy dashboard using AI/ML satellite data and sensor data to offer insights to citizens and policymakers for evidence-based interventions.

title: Cognitive Opportunistic LEO-PNT Receiver System
description: Develop a Cognitive Opportunistic LEO-PNT receiver system to utilize signals of opportunity from LEO satellites for accurate positioning navigation and timing services overcoming vulnerabilities of traditional PNT systems by leveraging signals from various mega-constellations.

title: Screening Tool for Early Detection of Neurological Conditions
description: Develop a low-cost accessible screening tool for early detection of neurological conditions like Parkinson's and Alzheimer's that is non-invasive easy to use by primary healthcare workers and functions in resource-limited settings providing actionable referral outputs.

title: Mobile-based EHR Companion for ASHA Workers in Low-Internet Areas
description: Develop a mobile application for ASHA workers in rural India to manage electronic health records in areas with limited internet connectivity functioning offline storing data securely syncing automatically when internet is available and supporting local languages and voice input.

title: Digital Contact Tracing and Screening Tool for MDR Pathogens in Hospitals
description: Develop a digital solution to trace contacts and screen for Multi-Drug Resistant pathogens in hospitals leveraging hospital data patient interactions and real-time inputs to identify potential outbreaks early and suggest containment protocols.

title: VR and Eye-Tracking Solution to Capture Customer Reactions for EV Product Design
description: Create a VR experience with eye-tracking to capture customer reactions to EV designs gathering data on gaze patterns and attention to improve ergonomics aesthetics and user experience simulating EV models and generating heatmaps and analytics.

title: Digital Twin for CO2 Capture in Urban Settings
description: Create a digital twin for an urban area to simulate CO2 emissions dispersion and capture methods designing a software prototype that models CO2 flow integrates sensor data and evaluates different capture strategies to support urban planning.

title: Rare-Earth-Free High-Efficiency Motors
description: Develop high-efficiency electric motors that do not rely on rare-earth magnets creating a motor with comparable or superior performance using alternative materials and designs with students expected to design and validate a prototype motor concept.

title: Stealth Coating for Defense Assets
description: Develop an indigenous cost-effective stealth coating for defense assets to reduce radar cross-section and infrared signatures that is durable weather-resistant and field-deployable with a lab-scale formulation demonstrating effectiveness.

title: Low-Cost Hydrogen Storage Cylinder
description: Design a cost-effective lightweight and safe hydrogen storage cylinder to promote hydrogen as a clean energy source utilizing new materials or fabrication techniques to reduce costs and meet safety standards.

title: AI Tool for Early-Stage Dementia Detection
description: Develop an AI-based screening tool to detect early signs of dementia by analyzing speech behavior and cognitive patterns providing risk scores for clinical referral as a mobile or web-based cognitive screening application.

title: Cloudburst Early Warning and Alarm System
description: Develop a real-time early warning system for cloudbursts in hilly regions utilizing sensor networks weather radar data and AI to predict rainfall anomalies and alert local authorities and residents.

title: Cryptocurrency address collection and categorization system
description: Create a system to collect and categorize cryptocurrency addresses from various online sources associating them with suspect entities through internet scraping data storage and providing an analytical front-end for querying data and exporting results.

title: Identification of URL based attacks from IP data
description: Develop a system to identify URL-based cyberattacks using IP data detecting various attack types visualizing results allowing data export and ingesting external PCAP data for attack identification.

title: Identification and protection of Virtual Network Computing VNC based data exfiltration attacks
description: Develop a system that simulates various data exfiltration scenarios using TigerVNC and RealVNC and suggests defense mechanisms to detect and prevent data exfiltration attacks using Virtual Network Computing servers.

title: Design and build a multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation RAG system using LLM for OFFLINE mode
description: Build a multimodal RAG system that can ingest index and query diverse data formats like DOC PDF images and audio recordings supporting natural language queries generating grounded summaries with a unified query interface and cross-format search in offline mode.

title: Detection of Open Crust Mining Activity and 3D visualization
description: Develop a software tool to automatically detect and visualize open crust mining activity from satellite imagery identifying mining areas calculating mining depth and volume generating reports with 3D visualization and an interactive mapping platform integration.

title: Automated Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing tool for CCTV cameras and DVRs
description: Develop an automated Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing tool for CCTV cameras and DVRs scanning for vulnerabilities simulating attacks and using machine learning for anomaly detection and vulnerability prediction.

title: Centralized Vulnerability Detection and Intelligent Query Interface
description: Develop a centralized vulnerability detection system with a web GUI integrating various scanning tools aggregating scan results correlating them with threat intelligence and providing a RAG-based chatbot for natural language queries on vulnerabilities.

title: Portable log analysis tool for isolated network
description: Develop a portable log analysis tool for isolated networks to monitor cybersecurity events collecting parsing and analyzing logs from various sources without relying on external services with offline functionality multi-source log collection and reporting capabilities.

title: Application software to obfuscate object file using Low Level Virtual Machine LLVM
description: Develop an application that obfuscates object files generated from C and C++ code using LLVM generating obfuscated binaries for Windows and Linux making them difficult to reverse engineer and providing a report detailing the obfuscation process.

title: Multi-Platform System Hardening Tool
description: Develop an automated cross-platform security hardening tool that assesses enforces and reports compliance for operating systems including Windows Ubuntu and CentOS to replace the manual time-consuming and error-prone hardening process.

title: Development of Threat rules in ELK Stack for detecting Advanced Persistent Threats APTs
description: Develop threat rules within an ELK stack Elasticsearch Logstash Kibana to detect Advanced Persistent Threats by analyzing log data from various sources to identify suspicious activities indicative of APT attacks using APT samples for realistic data generation.

title: AI/ML-Based Identification of Cryptographic Primitives and Protocols in Multi-Architecture Firmware Binaries
description: Develop an AI/ML-based framework to automatically identify and analyze cryptographic primitives and protocols within firmware binaries across various architectures detecting known and proprietary crypto implementations and identifying protocol patterns in black-box firmware.

title: AI/ML based text-to-text machine translation from Nepalese and Sinhalese to English
description: Develop AI/ML-based software to translate printed text from Nepalese and Sinhalese languages into English to make literature accessible to a wider audience overcoming the limitations of manual translation.

title: Empowering Gram Panchayats to manage daily Operation and Maintenance of Rural Piped Water Supply Systems using low-cost digital tools
description: Empower Gram Panchayats to manage rural piped water supply systems using low-cost digital tools for monitoring preventive maintenance and water quality checks to improve functionality efficiency and sustainability of these systems.

title: Deep learning based Audio Language Model that can Listen Think and Understand speech and non-speech
description: Develop an Audio Language Model that can understand both speech and non-speech audio signals capable of speech recognition audio event detection speaker diarization and paralinguistic analysis using a dataset including Asian languages.

title: AI-Based Underwater Image Enhancement System for Increased Maritime Security
description: Develop an AI-driven system to enhance underwater images for improved maritime security addressing low visibility and color distortion to enable better threat detection and reconnaissance deployable on edge devices for real-time image enhancement.

title: User and Entity Behaviour Analytics UEBA for internal threat identification
description: Develop a UEBA solution leveraging machine learning to detect anomalies in user behavior to identify internal threats within an organization overcoming the limitations of traditional security tools.

title: Automated Comprehensive Technology Intelligence and Forecasting Platform
description: Develop an automated platform for DRDO to gather and analyze technology intelligence forecast trends and aid strategic decision-making integrating data from various sources providing real-time updates and generating forecasts to replace time-consuming manual methods.

title: AI-powered monitoring of crop health soil condition and pest risks using multispectral imaging and sensor data
description: Develop an AI-powered platform for monitoring crop health soil conditions and pest risks using multispectral/hyperspectral imaging and sensor data integrating remote sensing to provide timely insights and actionable alerts for proactive crop management using AI ML and DL techniques.

title: Accelerating High-Fidelity Road Network Modeling for Indian Traffic Simulations
description: Develop toolsets and workflows to accelerate creation of detailed digital twins of Indian road networks for realistic traffic simulations incorporating features like potholes and erratic driver behavior to improve traffic management and infrastructure planning.
